RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path amid housing correction

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off; oil spike and rising bond yields pressure equity risk appetite. BHP hit by class action. Copper (Flagship) and gold exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) show selective strength.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from oil-driven inflation fears and Chinese demand concerns. Copper and gold juniors offer relative outperformance.

sectors.trend: Banks tumbling alongside miners as oil-driven yield surge and growth scare weigh on credit and rate expectations. RBA rental inflation concern adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. Rising fixed mortgage rates (5/1 ARM past 7%) may support NIM but growth scare caps upside.

sectors.trend: Strongly bullish. Brent crosses $100, highest since May. Australia softens gas reservation rules. Oil 'explosion' as price suppression fails.
sectors.implications: Woods Point, Oil Search, and gas-exposed names benefit. LNG exporters gain from softer reservation rules easing Asian supply fears.

sectors.trend: Woolworths price-freeze breach undermines consumer confidence. Businesses 'fear for their future.' Housing correction supports first-home buyer activity.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs (oil). Housing correction may boost building/consumer discretionary over time.

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout accelerates; power giant targets coal plant sites. 25 new data centres proposed. OpenAI-Samsung chip cooperation.
sectors.implications: Supports AGL.AX, CSG.AX, and infrastructure REITs. Long-term structural tailwind for power and data infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Nursing graduates face rural 'trial by fire'; MATES charity targets suicide in heavy industries. Limited direct ASX impact.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX broadly unaffected; rural health workforce strain may support long-term demand.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure (1–3% range) as oil stays elevated, bond yields rise, and AUD weakens. Miners and banks remain laggards. Energy and gold juniors provide relative strength. RBA commentary on rental inflation will be key catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and Chinese demand stabilises. AI/data centre buildout and gas policy reform offer structural support. Housing correction may create entry points in affordable segments. Key risk: prolonged Middle East conflict or Chinese demand collapse.
